tei:div.tei:p: 103) rgyal kun spyi mes kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab shrī seng*// o rgyan yab yum rje 'bangs lo paṇa dang*// karma gling pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ /nyi zla chos rje nyi zla 'od zer mtshan// nam mkha'i mtshan sogs bka' bab brgyud ldan gyi// rtsa brgyud bla ma skyabs mchog kun 'dus dngos// drin chen bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūḥ 'khor 'das dmigs med sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sprin// zhi ba rdor dbyings 'bar ba khrag 'thung dang*// dag pa rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas// mchod par 'os rnams zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ (104)
